item.tib: kun 'dus rin chen rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba nyi zer dra ba
item.coloph: rtsa rgyud kun 'dus kyi 'grel ba nyi zer drwa ba zhes bya ba paN Ti ta chen po kha che dpal 'bar gyang ti gsas dang / lo tswa ba bod kyi bon po gsas mkhar me 'bar dang / bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' rnams kyis gtan la phab cing bshad pa'o/ rdzogs so// sgya 'phrul gyi bon la shin tu sbyangs ba gyer spungs chen po mu la rad Na'i lugs so/ de la shang pa byang gter gyis/ kun 'dus rin chen rtsa rgyud 'grel ba dang bcas pa 'di/ bsam yas skor khang nas a tsa ra mi gsum gyis gter nas thon/ de la ban d+he mi gsum gyis zhus/ de yis gze bon sgur po la/ rnel byed ne gus zhus/ de la zhang mo sgom pa rong mos zhus/ de la rmeng rog dbal pos zhus/ de (la) rje lha ri gnyen pos zhus/ de la shang pa jo gzhon gyis zhus/ de la gtsang pa dpal shes zhus/ de la g.yo ston nam mkha' rin chen gyis zhus/ de la zhang ston sher gzhon gyis zhus/ de la gco bon shes rab kyis zhus/ de la gco tsun smon lam blo gros kyis zhus so/ yang g.yo ston chen po nam mkha' rin chen gyi drung du/ bka' rgyud chen po 'di zhang ston shel gzhon gyis zhus/ de la gshen btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes blo gros kyis lung dang bcas pa zhus/ de la gco btsun smon lam blo gros bdag gis/ dpe dbang rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhus so//

item.tib: kun 'dus rin chen rtsa rgyud kyis 'grel pa nyi zer drwa ba
item.coloph: rtsa rgyud kun 'dus lus kyi 'grel ba nyi zer drwa ba zhes bya ba pin+ha ta chen po kha che dpal 'bar gyang ti gsas dang / lo tsA ba bod kyis (kyi) bon po gsas mkhar me 'bar dang / bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' rnams kyis gtan la phab cing bshad pa rdzogs snyo// sgya 'phrul gyis bon la shin tu sbyangs ba/ gyer spungs chen po mu la rad na'i lugs s+ha/ de la shang pa byang gter gyis (gyi/)kun 'dus rin chen rtsa rgyud 'grel ba dang bcas pa 'di/ bsam yas bskor (dkor) khang nas a tsa ra mi gsum gyi (gyis) gter nas thon/ de la bar+he mi gsum gyis zhus/ de yi gze bon sgur po la/ rnol byed ne gus zhus/ de la zhang mo sgom pa rong mos zhus/ de la rmong rog dbal pos zhus/ de la lha rje ru gnyan pos zhus/ de la shangs pa jo gzhon gyis zhus/ de la gtsang pa dpal shes kyis zhus/ de la g.yo ston nam mkha' rin chen gyis zhus/ de la zhang ston sher gzhon gyis zhus/ de la gtso bon shes rab kyis zhus/ de la gtso btsun smon lam blo gros kyis zhus/ yang g.yo ston chen po nam mkha' rin chen gyis (gyi) drung du/ bka' rgyud chen po 'di zhang ston sher gzhon gyis zhus/ de la gshen btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes blo gros kyis lung dang bcas pa zhus/ de la tso btsun smon lam blo gros bdag gis dpe dbang rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhus so//
